item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera visits a science museum in Jaipur and sees four old time-measuring devices. Her teacher asks her which statement correctly matches a device to the observable change it uses to show the passage of time.
Which statement is correct?

options.A: A sundial shows time by the changing position of the shadow cast by sunlight.
options.B: A sundial keeps showing time at night by the shadow it casts without sunlight.
options.C: A candle clock measures time because its flame grows dimmer as time passes.
options.D: An hourglass measures time by water flowing from its upper bulb to its lower bulb.
